headline: US Approved Nearly 900,000 AI Chips for Chinese Companies to Buy
seoTitle: US Approved AI Chip Sales to China
metaDescription: A report from a US House committee reveals that the government authorized the sale of 900,000 AI chips from Nvidia and AMD to Chinese entities recently.
aiSummaryBullets: A US House committee reported the approval of approximately 900,000 AI chip shipments to China over a six-month period.
The authorized products include AI processors manufactured by Nvidia and AMD.
Regulators permitted these sales to companies currently listed on a Pentagon registry of firms suspected of Chinese military ties.
aiContextParagraph: A recent assessment by a United States House committee highlights that federal authorities approved significant shipments of artificial intelligence technology to entities based in China. The report indicates that between early and mid-2026, the US government authorized the export of nearly 900,000 AI-focused semiconductor units. These hardware components, designed for high-performance computing, were produced by major domestic technology firms Nvidia and AMD. According to the committee's findings, the recipients of these exports include various Chinese corporations that appear on the Pentagon's official list of entities alleged to maintain links with the Chinese military establishment. The disclosure follows ongoing international debates regarding export controls on sensitive technology. The information provided by the committee serves as the primary source for these details, detailing the scale of approved hardware transfers that occurred during the monitored six-month timeframe.
whyItIsViral: The story is gaining traction due to significant public interest in trade policies regarding China, supported by moderate search volume and reporting by major regional outlets.

sources.articleTitle: US signed off on sales of nearly 900,000 AI chips to China in six months, House committee says
